learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to apply methods of industrial measurement and testing technology and to understand the function and limits of measurement and testing systems.
Students know the structure and components of mechatronic measurement and testing systems and can apply such systems.
Based on the learned basics of measurement technology, students can decide which measurement method is suitable for the respective task.
Collect and document all necessary information.
Plan a project and adhere to time specifications.

syllabus_topics: Components of mechatronic measurement and testing systems
Form, dimension and position tolerances from the perspective of metrology
Interfaces of mechatronic measurement and testing systems
Hardware and software components and control systems
Applications of mechatronic measurement and testing systems in additive manufacturing machines, automated manufacturing, foundries and plastic injection molding
Selection and definition of the development topic
Creation of the project specification, time planning
Analysis of the state of the art of the development project
assessment_rules: The grade for MECB640 is formed in equal parts from MECB641 and MECB642. For MECB641, students can choose between a 60-minute written exam, a 20-minute oral exam, or a 20-minute presentation. Laboratory reports accompany MECB641 but are not graded.
bibliography: Eignungsnachweis von Prüfprozessen, Prüfmittelfähigkeit und Messunsicherheit im aktuellen Normenumfeld, E. Dietrich, A. Schulze
institution: Hochschule Karlsruhe - Technik Und Wirtschaft — Mechatronik (B.Eng.)
